messages:
ravi: Heads-up — since 09:12 UTC we're seeing p99 token latency jump ~2.1s in eu-west. Correlates with sustained P2P/PCIe bursts on a subset of racks (r9-r11). Not classic egress saturation.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Alert: GPU_LATENCY_HIGH eu-west-1 — 12 nodes flagged. Paging routed to #eng-infra.

maya: any logs or a quick sample?

ravi: quick nvlink/nvidia-smi snip below from one affected host (sanitized):
```
GPU0 util 98%  memory 11.9G/12G  p2p_rx=13.4GB/s p2p_tx=13.1GB/s
GPU1 util 12%  memory 1.1G/12G   p2p_rx=0.2GB/s  p2p_tx=0.1GB/s
PCIe root delta spikes aligned to 09:11:46 - 09:13:10
Kernel logs show repeated dma-burst warnings but no OOM.
```

alex: looks like co-located workloads pinned to sockets on the same PCIe root are creating cross-socket traffic storms. We saw similar in staging when a training job pinned to socket-1 hammered P2P. Two quick mitigations: (A) socket-anti-affinity scheduling to avoid packing multi-tenant GPUs on the same root; (B) temporary fractional-shed of best-effort slices in eu-west for noisy tenants until we stabilize routing.

maya: fractional-shed will impact throughput/cost. How big is the win?

ravi: empirically last time socket-anti-affinity dropped p99 by ~60%. Fractional shedding buys additional headroom but costs more (we estimated +$650/day if we shift certain workloads to reserved/dedicated-like routing for a day).

eng-scheduler: eng-scheduler: can push an immediate canary config to avoid scheduling on the same NUMA socket in az-a. Example quick config (runtime accepts simple YAML patch):
```
strategy: socket_anti_affinity
scope: az-a
exceptions: [critical_dedicated]
thresholds:
  p99_ms: 1200
  sustained_window_s: 300
```

alex: also saw NIC interrupt coalescing exacerbates sudden DMA bursts. A small debounce on NIC IRQs reduced kernel-level burstiness in lab. I'll open a PR to default soft-debounce for eu-west fleets.

maya: plan suggestion: (1) canary socket-anti-affinity -> az-a now; (2) automated fractional-shed of best-effort tenants in region if p99 > 1.2s for 5m; (3) follow-through NIC debounce PR and telemetry dash to capture P2P rates per root. @oncall-bot please create the incident stub and runbook.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260321-47. Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/INC-20260321-47 (ops only).

ravi: rolling the canary to az-a (deployment id: canary-20260321-3). Watching metrics.

alex: immediate numbers from canary nodes: p99 dropped to ~450ms, mean stable. Looks promising :thumbsup:.

maya: good catch team — add cost owners and postmortem owners. We'll evaluate ROI before rolling cross-region. I'll log action items in the incident.

ravi: I'll keep updating in thread with telemetry. If anyone sees regression call me directly.
